mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 64 degrees with overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park and a New Moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Verona Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This document was developed through extensive community input and serves as a long-term roadmap for housing, transportation, and sustainable growth in our city.

We have a busy schedule ahead! You can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, local trivia options include Hop Haus at 6:30 PM, Wisconsin Brewing Company at 6:30 PM, and events continuing through the week.
In a recent report, the Verona Police Department noted that on September 28, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash at the intersection of CTH-PB and CTH-M involving a rear-end collision.
Today's featured flavor is Georgia Peach. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
